attr.title: Alto's Adventure
attr.desc: Testing candidate 0.2.0-rc1: Android Alto 1.8.8 with offline controller adaptation. Verified only on RG35XX-H/KNULLI; other devices and CFWs need testing.
attr.inst: Copy your exact Alto 1.8.8 APK as altos-adventure-1-8-8.apk into ports/altosadventure, then launch Alto's Adventure. First launch verifies and installs everything automatically; no terminal or second script is needed. APK SHA-256: efb8eb2054e6c66173fc1638e6d005f048b48446b6029c4fdcb8aa8b9dcaaae0.
